name: ICD10CM_Embedding_Benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating vector embeddings of ICD-10-CM medical codes and clinical text: measures how well embeddings capture code semantics for retrieval, nearest-neighbor lookup, and clustering tasks. It is intended to assess clinical embedding quality for downstream information retrieval and classification in medical contexts.
evaluation_method: retrieval metrics such as mean_average_precision (mAP) and precision@k, plus nearest-neighbor accuracy
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset used by researchers working on clinical embeddings and ICD code representations; limited but growing adoption.
